comparison.independent_generalization_units: rooms/configurations (4); no naive p-values over speaker×RIR rows

150_300.common_floor_plus_3db_rule: C_i = max(F_A_i, F_B_i) + 3 dB; T <= C is censored

300_600.common_floor_plus_3db_rule: C_i = max(F_A_i, F_B_i) + 3 dB; T <= C is censored

interpretation: Censored pairs are intervals, not discarded rows. Positive lower bounds are guaranteed candidate wins; both-floor rows remain unresolved.
limitations: The benchmark covers 4 measured-RIR rooms/configurations from Aachen Impulse Response Database AIR v1.4; it does not establish universal room generalization.
Common-floor bounds depend on the fixed dry-control floor estimate and +3 dB threshold.
Speaker×RIR pairs are correlated; do not use naive p-values as if each were an independent room.
